# Questions the policy service refuses instead of deciding, one key per
# line: subject, action, resource. None: the one class that was listed,
# an operator asked an action the schema does not apply to an operator,
# is named apart by the service and read as a denial by the client
# (ADR-0167). A question refused for any other reason is not decided,
# and the suite fails until it is listed here.
# docs/architecture/policy-matrix.md explains.
